title: Sidewalk Replacement Program
description: Use this service request to obtain a petition to participate in a cost share residential sidewalk replacement program that assists in replacing existing deteriorated residential sidewalks. ** Sidewalks are the responsibility of the home owner. ** This is a cost share program between the City and the citizen (home owner). Not for businesses. ** For updates or additional information Click Here  The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to join the residential sidewalk cost-share program.
actions.why: For an owner seeking a petition to replace an existing deteriorated residential sidewalk, including broken, raised, or sunken concrete or damage from tree roots. The 311 request form asks whether you own the property, the sidewalk or curb problem, and where the petition should be mailed; the program is a City and homeowner cost share and is not for businesses.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Sidewalk Replacement Program" requests is not for businesses or for people who do not own the property. If you are not the owner and the sidewalk concern is not hazardous, then submit a "Code Concerns" 311 request instead. If the sidewalk is hazardous, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Sidewalk Replacement Program"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Sidewalk Replacement Program"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a sidewalk concern if you are not the property owner.
actions.why: For a sidewalk concern when you are not the property owner and the sidewalk is not hazardous. The 311 request form for "Sidewalk Replacement Program" requests directs nonowners to "Code Concern"; the saved matching service type is "Code Concerns" and its description covers code concerns such as substandard conditions.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a hazardous sidewalk if you are not the owner.
actions.why: For a hazardous sidewalk when you are not the property owner. The 311 request form for "Sidewalk Replacement Program" directs nonowners with a hazardous sidewalk to call 311 by phone.
